question: Which great deities can be subjected to delusion by this power?
premises: The speaker declares a future act of deluding.
Brahma is named as a possible object of delusion.
Vishnu and Maheshvara are also named as possible objects.
inference: Even Brahma, Vishnu, or Maheshvara can be deluded by this power.
plain_english: I shall delude Brahma, or even Vishnu or Maheshvara.
